Every day brings a new meme. Donald Trump at the party convention in Dallas made yet another loud promise in his style – to pay every adult US citizen $5,000. But there's a catch — Republicans need to maintain their majority in both the House of Representatives and the Senate in the midterm elections in November.

At the same time, he added a colorful detail: these funds could only be spent within the country. He didn't clarify exactly how he plans to monitor the geography of spending.

🖍From a practical standpoint, the plan looks like pure populism. The USA has about 270 million adults, meaning implementing the idea would cost the budget a colossal $1.35 trillion. Trump himself is convinced he can pull it off without lawmakers' approval.

🚩However, without a vote on Capitol Hill, distributing such funds is legally impossible. He had already pushed a similar idea about $2,000 checks funded by tariffs, but that fizzled out at the discussion stage.
